name: AppFlowy
description: Open source workspace for notes, wikis, tasks and databases, a self-hosted alternative to Notion.
note: Open the domain in a browser or set it as the self-hosted server in the AppFlowy apps. The admin console is at /console; sign in there with the admin email and generated password (Variables tab). Anyone who can reach the domain can sign up while DISABLE_SIGNUP is false. When your accounts exist, set DISABLE_SIGNUP to true in the Variables tab and redeploy.
